items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: I started taking lessons from Erskine Tate's father. That's old man Jackson at 31st.

ctx.x: And Father Kelly was my pastor with the Reagan Colts over at 59th and Halstead. You know, not 59th and Halstead. I mean it's 55th and Halstead. And I started taking lessons from Erskine Tate's father. That's old man Jackson at 31st.

items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: Me and Tony used to go... Me and Tony. And what's the other fellow's name? ... Tony died.

ctx.x: Me and Tony used to go... You know when he wrote the song there? Yeah, pretty big. Me and Tony. And what's the other fellow's name? Let me get it right now. Not only Tony. What you call him? But he wrote all those songs. Tony died.
